nutrition_sufficiency_gate: energy_kcal_raw AND fat_raw AND protein_raw must all be non-empty. Partial panels where fat_raw OR protein_raw is absent are TRANSPARENCY_NULL — the score engine requires both fat and protein to run a full panel. Fat is a core differentiator for this category (fat-tier labeling); a product with no fat value would be mis-graded as fat-absent.
filter_logic: Name-based and barcode-based exclusion gate applied in R1–R8 priority order; R9 nutrition sufficiency gate applied last on remaining in-scope products. Same two-stage pattern as run_cheese_001 / run_cereals_002.

exclusion_rules.R1_NON_FOOD: Barcode 7290108351613 (floor cleaner 'נוזל רצפות מלון חלומי') matched on halloumi acquisition keyword. Any non-food product is OUT_OF_SCOPE.
exclusion_rules.R2_NON_CHEESE_BAKERY: Berman Bread products (barcodes 497358, 4033583) matched on halloumi acquisition keyword. Not dairy cheese.
exclusion_rules.R3_NON_CHEESE_ICE_CREAM: Ice cream products (גלידת) are not table cheeses. Sec 1.3 (c).
exclusion_rules.R4_RICOTTA_OUT: All ricotta products are OUT. Ricotta is a heat-coagulated whey cheese (not brine-preserved), consumed primarily as a cooking/baking ingredient in Israeli retail (ריקוטה לאפייה dominant shelf form). Not a brined cheese, not a table cheese. Out of scope for both brined-cheeses and cheese-spreads. Methodology Sec 1.3 ricotta ruling.
exclusion_rules.R5_PREPARED_PASTRY_OUT: Filo/pastry products (מעטפות פילו, פילו ריקוטה פרימיום) where cheese is a filling ingredient. Sec 1.3 (c).
exclusion_rules.R6_SAUCE_OUT: Sauce products (רוטב פטה ים תיכוני, רוטב אלפרדו עם ריקוטה). Sec 1.3 (c).
exclusion_rules.R7_SPREADABLE_OUT: Products explicitly labeled למריחה or ממרח בולגרית. Routes to cheese-spreads cream-cheese pool per Sec 1.3 boundary call. Brined-block בולגרית at any fat tier belongs in brined-cheeses; spreadable/whipped form does not.
exclusion_rules.R8_VEGAN_OUT: Plant-based feta-style products: Planty (almond/cashew), Violife (coconut oil, protein=0). Not dairy, not brined. Sec 1.3 (a)+(b).
exclusion_rules.R9_NULL_NUTRITION: Products where Shufersal rendered a partial or absent nutrition panel — specifically where fat_raw OR protein_raw is absent from parsed fields. Cannot be fully scored. Retained as TRANSPARENCY_NULL. OFF fill is absolutely prohibited (CLAUDE.md, TASK-238). Known Shufersal rendering gap (~20-25% of shelf); accepted by owner. Rule hardened 2026-06-13: previously required only 'fat_raw AND protein_raw both absent'; now requires BOTH present for IN_SCORED.

כדורי פטה בשמן מתובל (Nizan) — classified IN_SCORED. Feta balls in seasoned oil; the cheese itself is the primary food, oil is a preservation/presentation medium. Consumed as table cheese.

סלט קוביות בולגרית 25% (Nizan) — classified TRANSPARENCY_NULL. Has energy=282 and sodium=698 but fat_raw and protein_raw are absent from parsed panel. Partial panel insufficient for scoring.

בסגנון פטה יוונית טבעוני (Violife) — classified OUT_OF_SCOPE (VEGAN_OUT). Ingredients: water, coconut oil, starch. Protein=0. Not dairy, not brined.
